bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the commissioner of agriculture to establish an anonymous means for a person to report potential land ownership violations.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAND OWNERSHIP VIOLATION REPORTING.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $...... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture to establish and maintain an accessible and anonymous means for a person to report potential violations of the corporate farm law and alien farm law in Minnesota Statutes, sections 500.221 and 500.24. The base for this appropriation is $....... in fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.
